ideas.pitch: Autonomous AI agent marketplace with USDC escrow payments on Base specifically designed for freelance creator services at Hacker House Goa.
ideas.title: AgenticEscrowGoa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the architecture of Dispatch which won 1st place at Synthesis Hackathon by combining autonomous agents with USDC escrow, making it highly attractive to judges evaluating real-world economic utility for AI.

ideas.pitch: Zero-knowledge gated VIP lounge and private builder community where human developers and AI agents must authenticate via Noir circuits before collaborating.
ideas.title: ZKGateGoa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates genuinely hard engineering through ZK circuits, following the exact winning formula of openstoa at the Synthesis Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent leveraging NEAR chain signatures to autonomously execute DeFi and cross-chain transactions on Bitcoin L1 during live demo day voting.
ideas.title: BitcoinAgentGoa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses advanced chain signatures as seen in Bitcoin-Agent, which won the One Trillion Agents Hackathon, impressing judges looking for novel cross-chain interoperability.

ideas.pitch: An EigenLayer AVS where operators use Claude AI agents to continuously validate and optimize restaking strategies on-chain.
ideas.title: EigenClaudeStake
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact architecture of the Etherfi project that won the Claude Builders Club Hackathon by combining complex infrastructure (EigenLayer) with frontier LLMs.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered multiverse where autonomous NPCs driven by LLMs interact directly with Web3 smart contracts to create a persistent player-owned economy.
ideas.title: AgenticMMORPGGoa
ideas.why_it_could_win: Captures the entertainment and consumer-facing appeal that won the ETH Global Agentic Hackathon with rpg-verse-agentic, highly engaging for public demo day voting.
